atoms.text: Neither starfish nor jellyfish are actually fish. Perhaps the only thing they do have in common with fish is that they are marine animals. However, starfish and jellyfish share some similarities between themselves.

atoms.a: Why should the author support their claims?
b: ++ to make the text more believable
